concept: Soft Hours: a pianist plays in an open meadow at golden hour; a slow, quiet single screen with drifting phrases.

site.title: Soft Hours — A little more room
site.description: Unclench your shoulders. Leave the day at the door. A few quiet minutes, just for you
site.subheading: Unclench your shoulders. Leave the day at the door. A few quiet minutes, just for you
site.footer: Take your time. The world can wait
phrases: stay until the sky goes quiet
your thoughts can take the long way
we could stay a little longer
a song with nowhere to be
and let the world hum on

logo.idea: A half sun resting on two horizon lines.

loop.why: Slow, directionless motion reads the same forwards and backwards.
